caption: The drawing depicts a small figure constructed from what appears to be textured plant fibers or straw, arranged to form the shape of a human-like doll. The figure is dressed in a long, striped, light brown dress with a matching cape that covers the shoulders. The head is round, with simple facial features formed by small blue dots for eyes and a faint mark for the mouth, framed by light brown or tan material representing hair. Atop the head, there is a small, round hat adorned with light green and yellow flowers. The figure holds a fan in one hand, made from the same straw-like material as the rest of the body, and all the elements are rendered in subdued, natural hues of beige, light brown, tan, and muted green. The background is plain and off-white, which highlights the central figure without any additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Corn Husk Doll
